findings.summary: Imprint-year target lookup is duplicated across library result components.
findings.consequence: The same year-to-route lookup and guarded non-null route access must stay synchronized across result renderers; future changes to chronology route handling can drift between normal browse, all, latest, download, and source-download views.
findings.evidence: The owned line creates a local Map from props.imprintYearTargets. The same computed Map plus hasImprintYearTarget/imprintYearTo pattern appears in LibraryAllResults.vue, LibraryBrowseResults.vue, LibraryDownloadResults.vue, and LibraryLatestResults.vue, all consuming LibraryImprintYearTarget.
findings.recommendation: Extract a small shared helper or composable for LibraryImprintYearTarget arrays that returns hasTarget(year) and to(year), then reuse it in these result components while keeping parent target construction unchanged.
verification: Inspected owned line 63 and template consumers at lines 385-388 in app/components/library/LibrarySourceDownloadWorkspace.vue.
Compared the same imprint-year lookup pattern in LibraryAllResults.vue, LibraryBrowseResults.vue, LibraryDownloadResults.vue, and LibraryLatestResults.vue.
Verified LibraryImprintYearTarget is the shared model in app/lib/library/component-models.ts.

findings.summary: Download size formatting duplicates an existing library helper.
findings.consequence: The source-download popover and the library contract helper can diverge on thresholds, rounding, spacing, or zero-size behavior even though they expose the same byte-size label policy to users and tests.
findings.evidence: The owned computed block formats selected export bytes with the same 1_050_000-byte threshold, KB rounding, and MB precision implemented by formatLibrarySourceExportSize in app/lib/library/view-model.ts. Existing tests assert that helper's behavior in test/unit/library-contract.spec.ts, while source-download tests assert matching popover text separately.
findings.recommendation: Import and use formatLibrarySourceExportSize for downloadSizeLabel after summing selectedDownloadExports, keeping one formatting policy for source export sizes.
